datasets.name: Old landslide dataset of the southwest river basin of the Sichuan–Tibet area
datasets.verbatim: By focusing on the southwest river basin of the Sichuan–Tibet area, we collect 558 optical remote sensing images of old landslides in three channels from Google Earth and establish a dataset specifically for old landslide detection.

datasets.name: Google Earth images
datasets.verbatim: The dataset used in this study comprised Google Earth images with a spatial resolution of 2 m and covered a time span from 2012 to 2022.

methods.name: YOLOv8-CW
methods.summary: A landslide detection model built upon the YOLOv8 architecture. It integrates a CBAM (Convolutional Block Attention Module) into the backbone network and replaces the Complete-IoU loss function with the Wise-IoU loss function to improve detection accuracy and recall for old landslides.
methods.verbatim: In this paper, we introduce a novel landslide detection model known as YOLOv8-CW, built upon the YOLOv8 (You Only Look Once) architecture, to tackle the formidable challenge of identifying old landslides.

availability.author_statement: The datasets generated and/or analyzed during the current study are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not linked or made available, and the custom YOLOv8-CW code repository is not provided.
